method: If the cooked turkey breast is meant to be warm, sort that first; otherwise keep chilled fillings properly cold. Warm the cooked turkey breast through in the hot pan until piping hot and lightly coloured. It is already cooked, so stop before it dries out.
Build the greek flavour into the filling or dressing before it hits the bread, then taste it. It should taste good on its own before it becomes a sandwich.
Lay out the bread, spread right to the edges and add the wetter ingredients away from the bread where you can — nobody asked for a soggy lunch.
Pile in the cooked turkey breast, add the fresh bits for crunch, close it up and press gently so it holds together. Eat now, or wrap and chill promptly.
